description: Whether a result's receipt (an Ed25519 signature) seals exactly that request and that result, and every rule of its form holds (`reasons` names what does not). Pass the job's own `request` (as run_quantum_circuit or get_quantum_job returns it: a run here asks for its verdict, so the request it seals says so) and its result.

job.description: The job's text as it was given (preferred: read as the protocol reads it, so a member named twice or a number past what a parsed job keeps is seen), or the job as an object

method.description: The body's method as the host gave it: unsealed, and noted where it differs from what is sealed

status.description: The body's status as the host gave it: unsealed, and noted where it differs from what is sealed

name: verify_quantum_receipt

anyOf.description: Whether a result's receipt seals exactly that request and that result and every rule of its form holds, and the key it names.

form.description: The receipt's form: rfc8785, or first.

planner.description: For a job under a contract, what its reasoning says: the route chosen, the class wanted and given, whether the choice depends on the host, what was kept, and the shadow.

provider.description: For a provider's result, what it says of itself.

reasons.description: Each rule the receipt breaks (the provider protocol's section 8.4, wasmq_form among them for a wasmQ job): none when it is valid.

wasmq.description: For a wasmQ job (quantum-wasmq section 6.5), beside the verdict: how the run ended, each rule of the profile's form it breaks, and where the host's unsealed words differ from what is sealed, which change no verdict.

notes.description: Where the body's unsealed status or method differs from what is sealed or is missing, and members nothing seals: told beside the verdict, and no part of it.

outcome.description: The sealed result's status: ok, or fault.

problems.description: Each rule of quantum-wasmq section 6.5 the job breaks, in words (the reason wasmq_form): the first 64, then how many more. Empty when it breaks none.

anyOf.description: An estimate's check: its seal, every estimate's receipt, and the request re-run here giving the same figures.

reasons.description: The provider protocol's section 8.4 reasons: none, since an answer is run again only once its receipt and every rule hold; a receipt that fails is answered with its reasons alone.

rerun_error.description: Why the request could not be run again, when no host runs it (a request an estimate refuses): the answer is then not valid, and nothing is reproduced. Null when it ran.

anyOf.description: A set's check: the set's receipt over its request and head, the items the request gives at their indices, every item's own receipt, the root over the leaves and each item's path.

reasons.description: Each rule the set's receipt breaks (the provider protocol's sections 8.4 and 8.6): none when it is valid.

signer.description: That key as a did:key, where a surface gives it.

anyOf.description: Whether a result's receipt seals exactly that request and that result, and the key it names; for an estimate, also every estimate's receipt and the request re-run here; for a set, also every item's receipt, the root over them and each item's path.
A refusal as data: the message, every code in it (the last is the code), its outcome and meaning as the code's table gives them. A host that refuses for its own reasons gives the error alone.

outputSchema.description: Whether a result's receipt seals exactly that request and that result, and the key it names; for an estimate, also every estimate's receipt and the request re-run here; for a set, also every item's receipt, the root over them and each item's path.

title: Verify a result's receipt
